rule.statement: The court can consider the evidence of a surveyor in determining the value of land, even if they have not undergone professional training, if they have special knowledge and experience.
rule.supporting_quote: Cross, Evidence (6th ed., p. 442) observes: "It is for the Judge to determine whether the witness had undergone such a course of special study or experience as will render him expert in a particular subject and it is not necessary for the expertise to have been acquired professionally".
